attempts.summary: Fixed a corrupted /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script on node1 (it contained leftover heredoc artifacts instead of valid shell), made it executable, and installed a root crontab entry running it daily at 02:15 with output appended to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified the script runs and logs correctly, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id/service state, issued a native systemctl reboot, confirmed connection loss then recovery, proved boot_id changed (5fb1b173... -> ac5fb70b...), and confirmed crond, the cron entry, script permissions, and log data all survived the restart, with a fresh post-restart log append succeeding.
